description.value: Pepino's Spaghetti House is a neighbourhood Italian restaurant on Commercial Drive in East Vancouver, formerly operating as Nick's Spaghetti House and now reborn as a lively spot for pasta, pizza, and Italian mains. Situated on one of Vancouver's most walkable and cyclist-friendly thoroughfares, it offers both dine-in service and a full takeout menu. A sister wine bar, La Tana, operates next door at 635 Commercial Drive.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pepinos.ca is fully accessible and confirms the business name as 'Pepino's Spaghetti House', address as 631 Commercial Drive, Vancouver, BC V5L 3W3, and phone as 604-254-5633 — all consistent with OSM tags. The website has a full TAKE OUT MENU page and OSM tags 'takeaway=yes', confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cyclist amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. The OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the business is clearly in Vancouver (East Vancouver / Commercial Drive), which is flagged as a concern.
